Mobile API with AIDA Backend and JSONB
assets.raw:
Mobile POST /api/chat/message → AIDA Backend (4000)
  → HTTP proxy → Agentic-Subsystem POST /agents/chat (8001)
    → ChatAgent.run() → Runner.run() → OpenAI API (+ @function_tool calls)
    → Save user msg + AIDA response to conversations.log JSONB
    → Return {id, text, sender, timestamp, conversationId}
  ← Response propagates back
Mobile ← JSON response

Socket.IO (V1 foundation):
Mobile → chat:send → Pulseframe API (3000) → HTTP → Agentic-Subsystem (8001)
  ← chat:response (full response, not streamed)
